limits: Two runs per variant in fixed A/B/A/B order; no randomized order, confidence interval or PVT qualification
Software pending peak is not a hardware occupancy counter
No concurrent depth-one FPGA reference in this campaign
CPU-observed PRESENT completion; not scanout timestamp
32-byte selftest readback is not full framebuffer verification
Physical PIO waveforms and all-sample audio integrity not measured
DONE-to-ACK hardware idle/hold cycles are not measured; all measured intervals include host IO
Snapshot moves tag/error IO into the poll interval; compare poll plus metadata plus ACK, not metadata alone
Periodic sampling is not randomized; sampled means are not exact full-run totals
final_state: Queue 8 SRAM FPGA and queued RP2040 firmware; PCM stopped, explicit USB start gate
